# Travel MCP connectors

2 travel connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

The links open the setup guide for each connector and assistant on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All travel connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/travel](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/travel).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [apaleo](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/apaleo-to-mcp) | Hotel operations in the apaleo cloud property management system: properties, rooms and room types, rate plans and rates, availability and offers, bookings, reservations and guests, groups, folios, … | 48 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-apaleo-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-apaleo-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-apaleo-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-apaleo-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-apaleo-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-apaleo-to-muse) |
| [Lodgify](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/lodgify-to-mcp) | Vacation rental management in Lodgify: properties and room types, availability, nightly rates, quotes, bookings and enquiries, guest message threads, check-in and check-out, key codes and booking status changes. | 35 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-lodgify-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-lodgify-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-lodgify-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-lodgify-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-lodgify-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-lodgify-to-muse) |
